script_text: The Moon's volatile square to Mars in your 8th House turns your emotional defenses into a demolition derby this week. Early Week (Mon-Wed) crackles with intensity as Mercury in Leo sextiles your 5th House, sparking passionate conversations but also Mercury's square to Pluto in your 2nd House creates financial anxiety—Tuesday's worst day when Uranus opposes your Sun, triggering unexpected expenses. Mid-Week Turning Point arrives Wednesday when Venus trines your 10th House, transforming career ambitions into magnetic attraction that could unlock a promotion or raise. Late Week (Thu-Sun) brings relief as Jupiter sextiles your Moon in your 4th House, so family connections heal wounds and weekend plans solidify. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines your 10th House, aligning love and career momentum. Sunday is your worst day because Saturn squares your Moon, amplifying emotional stagnation. Trust your intuition during the full Moon in your 8th House on Thursday—it reveals hidden relationship truths. Follow for daily updates.
